text:
Anika: Quick thread — sketching a 'micro-cohort handshake' for design partners to reduce dropouts and get faster feedback :handshake:

Matt C: +1. Dropouts kill momentum. What's suggested cadence?

Anika: Proposal:
- Intake form (5 min)
- 30-min kickoff
- 6-week micro-cohort
  - weekly 15-min async check-in (Slack thread)
  - optional 30-min office hours per week
- Commitment: 1 engineer or PM ~2 hrs/wk
- Exit interview + short survey

Jasper: Keep most things async. Figma board + Looms work well. Suggest onboarding checklist — simple tasks to get to first integration.

Jasper: ```
Onboarding checklist:
- sign NDA
- share integration repo or API key
- run example request (curl)
- add one sample prompt
- join cohort Slack channel
```

Emily: Feedback capture matrix ideas:
- Product signal: integration live (yes/no)
- Quality: top 3 regressions or hallucinations
- Engagement: weekly active contributor count
Success criteria (pick 2/3):
1) Integration complete (customer can make requests)
2) 3 actionable product/ux issues reported
3) NPS >= 7 in exit survey

Oliver: Incentives: $500 cloud credit OR $750 referral credit + prioritized support + roadmap previews. Dropout policy: 2 missed weeks -> check-in, 3 missed weeks -> remove from active cohort (offer re-onboarding later).

Matt C: Need NDA signed and clear data handling rules. Also capture eval harness: curl example + prompt set and a tiny metrics script.

Anika: Draft 'commitment handshake' message to send to partners (short):

Anika: ```
Hi <Partner>,
Thanks for joining the micro-cohort. Quick confirmation:
- 6 weeks, ~2 hrs/wk from one engineer/PM
- Weekly async check-ins + 30-min office hours
- We'll run an exit interview + short survey
We offer $500 credit + prioritized support. By replying "I confirm" you acknowledge the commitment.
```

legal-bot: Note: use the standard DP NDA template v3 (link) — no special edits unless handling PII.

Emily: Also plan an exit metrics review 2 weeks after exit (stability + usage). Capture before/after prompt quality scores.

Anika: Can we ship the intake form + handshake by EOW? Owners: @Jasper -> intake form, @Oliver -> incentive copy, @Anika -> cohort messaging. Reactions ok?

Matt C: :thumbsup:

Jasper: I'll draft intake form and post prototype tomorrow.

Oliver: I'll prep incentives and a short FAQ for partners.

Anika: Thanks team — we'll iterate.
